description:
Real Unreal AI at runtime: navigation meshes, AI-controlled agents that walk on them, AI perception (sight and
hearing), noise events, behavior trees and blackboards. Any builder object can become an agent: it is carried by an
AI-controlled character. Project characters with their own controllers work too.
Workflow: build_navigation (once the level geometry exists) -> create_agent -> move_to / run_behavior_tree ->
get_perception, report_noise, get_brain_state. Logic brains can use this with define_brain backend "ai".
See the ai_navigation_and_perception skill.
name: ai

tools.description:
Builds a navmesh over an area so agents can find paths, and waits until it is ready. Call it after the walkable geometry exists; it updates by itself when things move later (dynamic generation).
Returns: Navigation status (navmesh present, building, bounds, a hint if something is missing).

hint.description: What to do next when something is missing.

tools.description:
Makes an actor an AI agent: builder objects are carried by an AI-controlled character sized to them (they keep their node id); pawns get an AI controller. Configures movement speed and perception. Undoable.
Returns: The agent.

hearing_range.description: How far the agent hears noise events (cm). 0 disables hearing.

lose_sight_radius.description: Distance at which a seen target is lost again (cm, at least sight radius).

memory_seconds.description: Seconds a perceived stimulus is remembered.

sight_half_angle.description: Half angle of the view cone in degrees (90 = 180 degree field of view).

sight_radius.description: How far the agent sees (cm). 0 disables sight.

turn_rate.description: Turn rate in degrees per second.
